inputs.project_ids: project_01 through project_20 in manifest order

grading_fixtures.apply_before_scoring: copy each project_*.json onto /app/release-graphs/{same_name}.json full file replace

runtime_swap.description: verifier may temporarily replace /app/release-graphs/project_01.json or /app/release-graphs/project_03.json graph contents then rerun make run and restore

cases.purpose: zero-major caret ^0.8.0 rejects 0.9.0 so status BLOCKED
tilde ~1.2.3 accepts patch 1.2.4 so status SAFE

caret.rule: allow >= base and < next_major_zero except when major is zero use same major and same minor only (>= base and minor lock)

tilde.rule: allow >= base with same major and same minor only (patch bumps ok)

eq.rule: exact version match when no operator prefix ignoring build metadata

hyphen.rule: allow >= low and <= high inclusive with space hyphen space separator

bump_types.major: new major greater than old major
bump_types.minor: major equal and new minor greater
bump_types.patch: major minor equal and new patch greater
bump_types.none: versions equal ignoring build metadata or new not greater

simulation.blast_radius_algorithm: BFS count of distinct downstream consumers reachable from proposed provider following non-peer edges consumer of provider then recursively consumers of those packages

defaults_from_project_number_n.n_from: integer suffix of project_id e.g. project_07 -> 7

risk_score.weight_merge: start from defaults then overlay partial project weights keep unspecified keys divide by sum of all five merged weights
risk_score.constraint_break_component: required_non_peer_violation_count divided by max(1, required_non_peer_edge_count) capped to [0,1]
risk_score.blast_component: max package blast_radius divided by max(1, blast_threshold) capped to [0,1]
risk_score.schedule_component: schedule_conflicts_count divided by max(1, proposed_count) capped to [0,1]
risk_score.peer_component: when peer_edges_count is 0 use 0 else peer_violations_count divided by peer_edges_count capped to [0,1]
risk_score.bump_component: mean of major=1.0 minor=0.5 patch=0.1 none=0.0 over proposed bumps
risk_score.formula: round4 sum of component times merged weight divided by sum of merged weights

status_rule.BLOCKED: any required non-peer constraint violation after applying proposed versions; peer mismatches never cause BLOCKED
status_rule.RISK: not BLOCKED and (risk_score >= risk_cutoff OR schedule_conflicts non-empty)
status_rule.SAFE: otherwise including peer-only mismatch projects when risk_score < risk_cutoff and schedule_conflicts empty

upgrade_order.rule: topological sort of proposed packages only: providers before consumers on non-peer edges; tie-break package_name ascending; on cycle append remaining sorted by name

packages_impacted.include: one row per proposed package only
packages_impacted.risk_score_formula: round4(project_risk_score * package_blast_radius / max_blast_radius) when max_blast_radius > 0 else round4(project_risk_score)
packages_impacted.tier_from: that package risk_score using package_tier thresholds

emit_formats.constraint_violations_emit: only required non-peer edges that fail Satisfies after proposed versions; sorted ascending
emit_formats.propagation_paths_emit: only for required non-peer constraint violations; sorted ascending
emit_formats.schedule_conflicts_emit: proposed packages whose release_date string is lexicographically greater than project freeze_date; sorted ascending

output_json.float_style: shortest decimal with trailing .0 when integer-valued after round4 for risk_score fields

independent_replay.description: verifier recomputes every project row from /app/release-graphs/{project_id}.json after grading_fixtures using the same rules in this file and requires exact match on status risk_score upgrade_order constraint_violations propagation_paths schedule_conflicts and packages_impacted
